question: How many licensed traffic engineers must a road agency employ per 100 centerline miles to comply with the MUTCD?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The evidence provided does not support any such requirement. The MUTCD does not specify a number of licensed traffic engineers that an agency must employ per 100 centerline miles (or per any mileage). In fact, the Support material clarifies that the MUTCD does not even mandate that an engineer make the final implementation decision — it only expects that traffic control device activities be conducted by duly authorized and qualified individuals. The evidence is insufficient to state any staffing ratio, because none exists in the provided text. Citations: - Section 1D.03 Support §4 (p.32) - Section 1A.04 Support §1 (p.2)
